models.name: MagpieTTS Multilingual 357M
models.license: NVIDIA Open Model License; runtime Apache-2.0; companion codec license must accompany distribution
models.note: Pinned MagpieTTS v2607 F16 generator and NanoCodec plus the authenticated tokenizer package; CPU-only, 22.05 kHz mono, macOS Apple silicon. Two GGUF files are downloaded directly and the tokenizer dictionaries are extracted from pinned append-only byte ranges of the .nemo archive; model_weights.ckpt is discarded. Every weight and tokenizer member is verified before loading. Languages are the runtime set supported by this build (Chinese and Japanese frontends are excluded).
